title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/13/2026
* Job Type Permanent
* Industry IT Services
* Salary 0
* Work Experience 1-3 years
* City Pune City
* State/Province Maharashtra
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 411001

**About Us**
------------

**CCTech**'s mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.

We have two business divisions: product and consulting.

simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.

Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a dynamic and people-centric **HR Business Partner (HRBP)** to support business leaders in driving people initiatives and fostering a high-performance work culture. The HRBP will act as a trusted partner to employees and managers, managing the employee lifecycle while ensuring alignment with business objectives and organizational values.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Partnering**

  

* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce needs and provide HR solutions aligned with business goals.
* Build strong relationships with managers and employees to enhance engagement and productivity.
* Provide guidance on HR policies, employee relations, and performance management.

**Employee Lifecycle Management**

  

* Manage end-to-end employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Conduct regular employee connect sessions and stay interviews to improve engagement and retention.
* Support induction and integration of new employees into the organization.

**Performance Management**

  

* Drive the performance management process, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback discussions, and development planning.
* Support managers in addressing performance concerns and creating performance improvement plans where required.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

  

* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, wellness activities, and team-building events.
* Promote company culture, values, and a positive employee experience.
* Analyze employee feedback and recommend improvement initiatives.

**Talent Management**

  

* Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to support hiring, workforce planning, and onboarding.
* Identify training and development needs and coordinate learning initiatives.
* Support succession planning and internal talent development programs.

**Employee Relations**

  

* Address employee concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Support conflict resolution and disciplinary processes in line with company policies.
* Ensure fair and consistent implementation of HR policies and practices.

**HR Analytics & Compliance**

  

* Prepare HR dashboards and reports on attrition, headcount, engagement, and other HR metrics.
* Maintain employee records and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable labor laws.
* Support HR audits and process improvement initiatives.

**Additional Responsibilities**

  

* Participate in HR projects, organizational change initiatives, and policy implementation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve HR processes and employee experience.
* Perform any additional responsibilities assigned by the management from time to time.

### **Requirements**

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.

**Experience**

* **1–3 years** of experience in HR Business Partnering, HR Generalist, or Human Resources.
* Experience in the IT/ITES industry is preferred.

**Required Skills**

  

* Strong understanding of HRBP practices and employee lifecycle management.
* Good knowledge of performance management and employee engagement.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to build trust and maintain confidentiality.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
* Working knowledge of labor laws and HR policies.
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS tools.

**Key Competencies**

  

* Business Acumen
* Stakeholder Management
* Employee Engagement
* Communication & Influencing
* Conflict Resolution
* Problem Solving
* Decision Making
* Ownership & Accountability
* Collaboration

Confidentiality & Integrity

### **Benefits**

* Opportunity to work with a dynamic and fast-paced engineering IT organization.
* Be part of a company that is passionate about transforming product development with technology.

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Operations
description:
This role leads the operating practices that keep DDN's IT services dependable as the company grows. Based in Pune, the Senior Manager owns incident, change, problem, and major incident management; establishes usable service and configuration data; and works closely with infrastructure monitoring teams. The position also provides on-site leadership in India and operational coordination across APAC and EMEA, while functional reporting relationships remain with the respective team leaders.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Service management**
----------------------

* Run and improve incident, major incident, change and problem management across IT, with clear ownership, escalation paths, communications and service restoration practices.
* Lead critical incident response, coordinate resolver teams, document timelines and follow through on root causes and corrective actions.
* Establish practical change assessment and approval controls, emergency change handling, post-implementation review, and meaningful service performance reporting.
* Maintain knowledge, procedures, and auditable evidence for service operations; partner with Security and Compliance on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness.
* Act as a Change and Problem Manager for IT changes.

**Configuration data, monitoring, and employee lifecycle**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the service-management side of the CMDB, including data quality, ownership, relationships, and a prioritized approach to critical-service visibility.
* Partner with Core Infrastructure on monitoring and event integrations, turning alerts into actionable incidents and reducing noise and repeat outages.
* Own the operational process for employee onboarding, moves, and offboarding, coordinating HR, IAM, endpoint, and the ESM platform team; ensure ownership, approvals, and handoffs are defined.
* Work with the ESM engineers to translate process requirements into workflows, SLAs, dashboards, and control evidence.

**Regional leadership**
-----------------------

* Provide local IT leadership for the Pune site and coordinate regional operating issues across APAC and EMEA without replacing existing functional line management.
* Coach distributed IT staff on service practices, escalation discipline, documentation, and employee communication.
* Use service metrics, trends, and employee feedback to focus improvements on the issues creating the most disruption.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in IT operations or service management, including 4+ years leading technical service operations or ITSM functions.
* Hands-on command of incident, major incident, change, and problem practices, preferably in a global support environment.
* Experience with an ITSM platform, service reporting, operational controls, knowledge management, and service-level management.
* Practical experience improving CMDB accuracy and working with monitoring, event management or observability teams.
* Experience leading teams or cross-functional operational groups across regions, including high-severity incident bridges.
* Sound judgment, clear written communication and the ability to balance service restoration, change risk and business urgency.

**Helpful experience**

* ITIL certification or equivalent practical experience; exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence requirements.
* Experience operating across India, EMEA, and APAC time zones and working with dotted-line stakeholders.
* Knowledge of automated incident routing, service mapping, and employee lifecycle workflow improvement.

**Initial priorities:** Establish consistent incident and change controls, a usable CMDB improvement plan, and predictable regional coverage and employee lifecycle handoffs

title: Sr Consultant – ICG Issue Remediation & Oversight
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Job Description**
===================

Infrastructure Issue Remediation and Oversight Support

**Location**
============

Pune

**Brief about role**
====================

The Infrastructure Issue Remediation Oversight Support is a key position within the Global Infrastructure Risk and Control team, supporting the remediation of global Infrastructure process and control gaps. The ideal candidate should be risk and control minded and must have a background in identifying and effectively remediating process and control gaps in a sustainable way at a large financial institution. The position is expected to provide risk-minded guidance to Infrastructure Technology teams and will report to Infrastructure Risk and Governance Support.

**Major Duties**
================

* Effectively support the global process and control issue remediation efforts.
* Manage the regional issue remediation activities and support management in execution of the defined objectives.
* Drive the Infrastructure Technology teams issue remediation to effective and sustainable solutions with minimal oversight.
* Support reporting on current state of on-going remediations.
* Establish working relationships and communications with key stakeholders globally across all lines of defense.
* Ensure that meetings are effective and deliverables are issued accurate, complete, and provided timely to stakeholders.

**Must Have**
=============

* 8+ years of experience in Financial Services with good understanding of Risk Management
* Keen in learning and ability to adapt to new technology and challenges
* Should have a good understanding of quality documentation and have strong skills to check and challenge the action plans and evidences provided by stakeholders
* Solid understanding of bank wide Controls, Standards, processes, regulations, risks and controls.
* Highly motivated, self-starter who deals well with ambiguity and can drive execution.
* Proven ability to build relationships, influence and motivate teams across the organization.
* Ability to challenge and influence stakeholders of differing viewpoints to reach consensus.

**Good to Have**
================

Internal Audit or Risk experience working at Big4 is a plus.

**Qualification**
=================

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: HRBP Programmes & Global Functions
description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Site HRBP is the hands-on HR partner for the Pune site, supporting leaders, managers and employees across the full employee lifecycle. The role combines practical day-to-day HR delivery with business partnering to enable compliant growth, strong workforce capability and an engaged, high-performing culture.
  
The HRBP ensures that local decisions and processes comply with applicable Indian and Maharashtra employment legislation, statutory requirements and company policies. Working in close partnership with the Site Director and the Global HR Director EWIS, the role converts business priorities into action, resolves issues at pace and builds scalable people practices for a growing operation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Hands-on Site HR Support**

* Be the visible and accessible first point of contact for managers and employees on people matters, providing practical advice and timely follow-through.
* Manage the employee lifecycle locally: onboarding, probation, employee changes, development, performance, absence, disciplinary and grievance matters, exits and offboarding.
* Coach managers to address people issues early, consistently and respectfully; personally drive cases to closure and maintain accurate documentation.
  

**Local Legislation, Compliance & Governance**

* Maintain strong working knowledge of applicable Indian and Maharashtra labour and employment requirements, including statutory registrations, working time, wages, leave, social security, employee relations, prevention of sexual harassment, health and safety, and record-retention obligations.
* Translate legal and policy requirements into practical site procedures, controls and manager guidance; coordinate with Legal, Payroll, EHS and external advisers where specialist input is required.
* Own HR compliance calendars, statutory records, audits and corrective actions. Identify risks early and escalate appropriately.
  

**Growth, Workforce Planning & Recruitment**

* Partner with site leadership on workforce plans, organisation design, capability needs and hiring priorities to support production ramp-up and sustainable growth.
* Build practical onboarding and workforce-readiness plans so new employees become productive safely and quickly.
* Drive disciplined goal setting, performance reviews, talent discussions, succession planning and development actions, with clear ownership and follow-up.
* Support leaders in building technical, supervisory and leadership capability for current operations and future growth.
  

**HR Operations, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure accurate and timely employee data, payroll inputs, benefits administration, letters, reports and personnel records.
Track practical KPI's such as headcount, attrition, absence, training completion, employee relations cases and compliance actions; convert insight into clear actions.  

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Work as one team with the Site Director, site leadership, Global HR Director EWIS, Centres of Expertise and regional/global HR colleagues.
* Demonstrate a collaborative, pragmatic and “get things done” mentality: take ownership, challenge constructively & communicate clearly.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Labour Relations or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of broad HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HRBP or site HR role in manufacturing, engineering or another operational environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience across employee relations, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, HR operations and organisational change.
* Strong practical knowledge of Indian labour and employment legislation and statutory compliance, with the ability to apply requirements in Maharashtra and a manufacturing-site context.
* Experience supporting workforce growth, production ramp-up or site expansion while maintaining compliance and employee experience.
* Professional-level English and strong local-language communication capability appropriate for the Pune workforce.
  

**Desirable:**

* Experience in aerospace, EWIS, automotive or regulated manufacturing.
* Experience working with factories, engineering teams and shop-floor populations in Pune or Maharashtra.
* Working knowledge of SAP, SuccessFactors, Wilbur or comparable HRIS and reporting tools.
* Recognised HR or labour-law qualification/certification.
* Experience partnering with global stakeholders in a matrix organisation.
* Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
  

Skills & Competencies

* Pragmatic, approachable and action oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.
* Able to balance employee advocacy, business needs, legal requirements and company values.
* Strong judgement, integrity and discretion when handling sensitive employee matters.
* Confident coaching and influencing managers at all levels; willing to challenge constructively.
* Structured and detail focused, with reliable follow-up, accurate documentation and strong case management.
* Data literate and able to turn HR metrics and workforce insight into decisions and actions.
* Comfortable working in a matrix: solid-line accountability to the Global HR Director EWIS and close dotted-line partnership with the Site Director.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A strategic role in shaping the future of aerospace manufacturing.
* A dynamic, international environment with opportunities for collaboration.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Strong focus on career development, innovation, and continuous learning.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

**A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working**

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

title: Assistant Manager - Human Resources
description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26147373  
**Job Category**Human Resources  
**Location**S. No 19 & 20, P4 Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Phase 1, Hinjewadi, Pune Mahar 411057, India  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**

* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.

* Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.

* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.

* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.

* Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.

* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

**Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**

* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.

* Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.

* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.

**Assisting in Managing Employee Development**

* Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

* Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.

* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.

* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs

* Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

**Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations**

* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).

* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.

* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner

* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.

* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.

* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

**Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**

* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.

* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.

* Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.

* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).

* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.

* Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.

* Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.

* Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

title: Training Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

The Finance Operations Learning & Capability Senior Specialist owns and continuously improves learning, onboarding and capability-building experiences across Finance Operations. Based in Pune with a global remit, the role leads new-hire onboarding and assimilation, professional-skills learning, early-career development, regional hub integration, knowledge-sharing initiatives, competency-framework activities, My Academy enablement, learning measurement and program governance.

The position partners with Finance leaders, process owners, subject-matter experts, HR, Talent Acquisition and enabling teams to convert business needs into practical, engaging and scalable solutions. The role combines facilitation, program management, employee experience, digital learning, stakeholder coordination, analytical thinking and disciplined operational execution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. New-hire onboarding, assimilation and employee experience**

* Own the end-to-end Finance Operations onboarding experience, including calendars, communications, facilitator scheduling, learning materials, assessments, feedback and follow-up actions.
* Deliver and continuously improve organizational orientation, foundational Finance Operations learning and new-hire assimilation activities.
* Coordinate with SDLs, GPOs, tower leaders, managers, subject-matter experts, HR and global stakeholders to provide a consistent and relevant experience.
* Act as an accessible point of contact for new hires during onboarding and early assimilation, directing questions and escalating concerns to the appropriate owner.
* Coordinate transportation-account creation and updates as part of onboarding, working with Transport, Facilities, vendors or administrative teams and maintaining accurate status tracking.
* Maintain onboarding trackers, attendance, completion records, assessment outcomes, stakeholder inputs and participant feedback during Onboarding.
* Develop reusable, blended and self-paced assets that improve continuity and reduce dependency on individual facilitators.

**2. Global hub integration, Bogotá Specific**

* Support the integration of the Bogotá hub into the broader Finance Operations learning and competency ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global standards while recognizing local needs.
* Partner with Bogotá leaders, trainers, subject-matter experts and HR contacts to understand capability priorities, onboarding requirements, stakeholder expectations and cultural or language considerations.
* Coordinate cross-hub learning calendars, knowledge-sharing sessions, facilitator support and reusable assets across Pune, Bogotá and other Finance centres.
* Promote consistency in foundational learning, competency expectations and employee experience while allowing appropriate local adaptation.
* Track hub-integration actions, dependencies, risks and feedback, and provide clear progress updates to Competency and Finance leadership.
* Enable transfer of good practices between hubs and maintain shared documentation so learning solutions can be reused and scaled globally.

**3. Learning needs analysis and solution design**

* Construct structured discussions with leaders, managers and process owners to identify learning needs, capability gaps and desired business outcomes.
* Design and deliver classroom, virtual, self-paced, e-learning and micro-learning solutions.
* Create/convert existing learning content such as DTP’s into e-learnings.
* Translate complex Finance, organizational and behavioral concepts into clear and practical learning experiences.
* Create and maintain courses, facilitator guides, participant materials, videos, quizzes, scenarios, simulations, checklists, job aids, playbooks and toolkits.
* Develop rapid learning solutions such as communication templates and quick-reference guides when the business requires timely support.
* Support Finance transformation, transition and knowledge-transfer initiatives from a learning and capability perspective.

**4. Competency framework and extended capability requirements**

* Partner with Finance leaders, process owners and HR to define and maintain relevant competency expectations for Finance Operations roles and career stages.
* Help translate role requirements into clear knowledge, skill and behavioural competency statements that can guide learning, development and career conversations.
* Support competency mapping, gap identification and prioritization across towers, teams, locations and employee segments.
* Connect identified competency gaps to appropriate curriculum, development pathways, learning assets, assessments or manager-led interventions.
* Maintain competency-related documentation, learning matrices and supporting resources, ensuring they remain current as roles, processes and technologies evolve.
* Provide data and qualitative insights on recurring capability needs to inform extended Competency priorities and future learning investments.
* Support communication and adoption of the competency framework so employees and managers understand how it can be used for development.

**5. My Academy and digital learning enablement**

* Use My Academy as a central channel to support the extended learning and competency needs of Finance Operations.
* Coordinate the creation, curation, publication and maintenance of Finance Operations learning content, pathways, curriculum and supporting resources in My Academy.
* Partner with content owners and subject-matter experts to validate course relevance, accuracy, ownership, review dates and intended learner audiences.
* Maintain content governance, naming conventions, version control and review cycles so learning resources remain current and easy to find.
* Support learner enrolment, assignment, campaign communication, completion follow-up and reporting in collaboration with the relevant platform or LMS owners.
* Use available platform insights(Workday, Menti-meter, Canva, MS-Forms) to understand participation, completion, content usage and learning gaps, and recommend improvements to curriculum and learner journeys.
* Promote awareness and adoption of My Academy through onboarding, learning campaigns, manager communication and self-directed development guidance.
* Identify opportunities to retire outdated or duplicate materials and improve the overall learner experience.

**6. AI integration and learning innovation**

* Identify and pilot responsible AI use cases that improve learning design, content creation, knowledge access, communication, reporting and administrative efficiency.
* Use approved AI tools to support first drafts, summaries, quizzes, scenarios, learning aids and content repurposing, with appropriate subject-matter review before publication.
* Explore AI-enabled approaches for personalized learning recommendations, recurring-question analysis, knowledge discovery and identification of content gaps.
* Partner with relevant technology, HR and governance stakeholders to ensure AI use complies with confidentiality, data-protection, intellectual-property and responsible-use requirements.
* Document AI-enabled workflows, quality checks, limitations and human-review responsibilities to enable safe and repeatable adoption.
* Share practical AI guidance and good practices with trainers, content owners and the wider Competency community.

**7. Personal excellence, soft skills and people development**

* Design and facilitate interventions in professional communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, problem solving, workplace effectiveness, business etiquette and personal excellence.
* Manage and publish the relevant learning calendar in partnership with Finance, Delivery, site leadership and HR.
* Facilitate programs for associates, interns, managers and other employee groups based on business priorities.
* Coach internal trainers and subject-matter experts through facilitator guidance, preparation, observation and feedback.
* Promote a learning culture through practice, reflection, feedback, knowledge sharing and manager involvement.

**8. Internship and early-career development**

* Coordinate the development components of Finance Operations internship and early-career programs from orientation through completion.
* Design and deliver classroom-to-corporate transition journeys, personal-excellence learning, engagement activities, assessments and development checkpoints.
* Coordinate assessments and consolidate results and stakeholder inputs to support deployment and development discussions.
* Partner with managers, HR and Talent Acquisition on team allocation, progress monitoring, learning interventions and conversion-readiness inputs.
* Maintain regular communication with interns and Intern Champions (Functional Managers), identify development or engagement risks and coordinate appropriate support.

title: HR Manager: Talent, Operations and Culture
description:
**Job description**

**HR Manager: Talent, Operations and Culture**

**Hadron GBS Pvt Ltd | Pune (Work from Office) | 10-15 years experience**

**Help us build the company people want to grow with**

Hadron GBS is a young IT services company growing fast. We work across staffing and fixed-cost project engagements, with teams in Pune, Singapore and the UAE. Over the next few months we will add many new colleagues, and the way we hire them, welcome them and look after them will decide what kind of company we become.

That is where you come in.

**The role**

As HR Manager, you will lead the three things that shape an employees experience from first conversation to long-term career: **Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and People and Culture.** You will work closely with the VP, Human Resources, and with business leaders, and you will lead the TA and HR Operations teams directly.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. We have a good foundation and a lot left to build, and you will have the room and the support to shape it.

**What you will do**

**Bring great people in**  
You will turn our growth plans into a hiring engine that attracts the right people and treats every candidate with respect. You will coach the TA team, strengthen our sourcing, referral and partner channels, and make sure a new joiners first impression of Hadron matches the reality.

**Make the everyday work smoothly**  
Behind every good employee experience is a dependable foundation: accurate payroll, clean records, clear policies, and compliance you never have to worry about. You will own this, improve it, and bring in better systems and automation as we scale. You will also work with our Singapore and UAE colleagues so that people across countries feel equally supported.

**Shape how it feels to work here**  
You will be the person colleagues trust. You will listen, resolve concerns fairly, and turn what you hear in surveys, exit conversations and day-to-day interactions into real change. You will help us run performance conversations that are honest and useful, support managers in leading well, and build engagement and recognition that feel genuine rather than staged.

**What success looks like**

* Teams are staffed with strong people, on time, and new joiners settle in quickly
* HR operations run so smoothly that people rarely have to think about them
* Employees say they feel heard, and good people choose to stay
* Managers feel supported by HR as a real partner in their work
* Our HR practices grow in step with the company, from 170 people to 250 and beyond

**Who you are**

* You have **10-15 years of HR experience**, with at least 4-5 years leading a team, and an MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field
* You have worked across hiring, HR operations and employee engagement, ideally in IT services, staffing or technology
* You have **exposure to international HR** and are comfortable working with teams across countries
* You know Indian labour laws and statutory compliance well, and you care about getting them right
* You are at ease with HRMS, payroll partners and recruitment tools, and you use data to guide decisions
* You are a clear communicator and an approachable leader, firm when needed and fair always

**It will help if you have** worked in a high-growth environment, understand staffing and T&M business models, or have built performance management systems and policies.

**What you will find here**

* Real ownership and direct access to senior leadership
* A chance to build HR systems and culture rather than inherit them
* Competitive pay aligned to your experience
* A collaborative, on-site team culture at our Pune office

**Interested?**

---------------

GKN Aerospace is a global leader in aerospace manufacturing, delivering advanced engineering solutions and high-performance components to the world’s top aircraft manufacturers. Performance Management

Strategic HR Leadership

* Act as a trusted advisor to the Site Director on workforce strategy, organizational design, and change management.
* Support site-level decision-making with HR analytics and insights.
Champion employee engagement and culture-building efforts.  

Operational Excellence (priority)

* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies.
* Implement global to local.
* Lead HR projects that improve operational efficiency and employee experience.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business transformation.

----------------------

Essential Qualifications

* A strategic role in shaping the future of aerospace manufacturing.
* A dynamic, international environment with opportunities for global travel and collaboration.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. title: Sr HR Generalist, India

Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.

With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench-assisted planar technology to provide industry-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium-voltage grid and infrastructure applications.

* Identify and apply for Maharashtra state incentives and related programs in partnership with Finance

Support headcount planning and organization design with site and global HR leadership  

**Benefits**

* Administer group medical insurance and other benefit programs; run renewals and vendor RFPs

* Handle employee relations matters, investigations and performance concerns with fairness and discretion

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive HR experience in India, including senior HR generalist, HR business partner or HR operations roles
* Working knowledge of SEZ requirements, Maharashtra state incentives, Indian labor law, statutory compliance and payroll

* Experience in a multinational company, ideally reporting to a US or global HR team

* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working across time zones with US-based teams

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a professional, well-organized, and service-oriented **Front Office Executive** to manage front office operations at our Pune office.

The incumbent will be the first point of contact for employees, visitors, customers, vendors, and other external stakeholders and will play an important role in creating a professional and welcoming workplace experience.

The role will be responsible for reception management, visitor coordination, telephone handling, meeting room coordination, courier and mail management, office administration, and day-to-day facility support. The successful candidate should be capable of independently managing a busy corporate front office while maintaining high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, safety, and service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Front Office & Visitor Management**

* Manage day-to-day front office and reception operations in a professional and efficient manner.
* Welcome and receive visitors, customers, vendors, interview candidates, and other guests.
* Maintain visitor records and ensure appropriate visitor registration and issuance of visitor badges/passes.
* Inform concerned employees promptly regarding visitor arrivals and coordinate visitor movement within the office.
* Ensure visitors are appropriately attended to while waiting and maintain a high standard of hospitality.
* Ensure that no unauthorized visitor enters restricted office areas without an appropriate employee/contact person.
* Provide visitors with relevant office, safety, and security information.
* Maintain the reception and waiting areas in a clean, professional, and presentable condition.
* Support visitors with information regarding local transportation, hotels, restaurants, taxi arrangements, and other requirements, where necessary.

**2. Telephone & Communication Management**

* Manage incoming calls received through the company's main telephone/reception number.
* Screen and route calls professionally to appropriate employees/functions.
* Respond to general enquiries and ensure accurate and timely communication.
* Manage the reception/facility mailbox and coordinate requests with the appropriate internal stakeholders.

**3. Meeting Room & Office Coordination**

* Coordinate the readiness of meeting rooms and common areas.
* Ensure meeting rooms are maintained in a professional condition and required supplies are available.
* Support meeting arrangements, including coordination for visitors, refreshments, room readiness, and other administrative requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams and service partners to resolve meeting room or workplace-related issues.

**4. Mail, Courier & Delivery Management**

* Receive, record, sort, and internally distribute incoming letters, couriers, and small packages.
* Coordinate outgoing courier and postal requirements.
* Liaise with courier, transport, and delivery service providers as required.
* Receive and appropriately process office deliveries.

**5. Facility & Office Administration Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative and facilities support to ensure smooth office operations.
* Coordinate employee and facility-related requests received through the reception/facilities desk.
* Support the management and issuance of office keys, access-related items, remote controls, and other company assets assigned through reception.
* Assist in coordinating employee and visitor parking facilities, wherever applicable.
* Monitor requirements for office stationery, paper, drinking water, meeting-room supplies, and other general office consumables and coordinate replenishment.
* Coordinate with facility management, housekeeping, security, and other service providers for routine requirements.
* Support basic administrative activities and documentation as required by the Administration/Facilities team.

**6. Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure front office activities are carried out in accordance with company security, safety, and visitor management procedures.
* Work closely with Security, Facilities, EHS, IT, HR, and other functions as required.
* Ensure appropriate confidentiality when dealing with visitor information, employee information, telephone calls, documents, and other sensitive matters.
* Promptly escalate any safety, security, facility, or visitor-related concerns to the appropriate stakeholder.

**Experience & Qualification**

* **5 to 10 years of overall professional experience**, preferably in front office, reception, administration, hospitality, or corporate facilities.
* **Minimum 5 years of direct experience in independently handling front office/reception operations** in a professional corporate environment.
* Graduate degree in any discipline. A qualification in Administration, Hospitality, Hotel Management, or a related discipline will be an advantage.
* Previous experience working in a **multinational company, large corporate office, engineering/manufacturing organization, or premium business/hospitality environment** would be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and customer-service orientation.
* Professional appearance, etiquette, and executive presence.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior management, employees, customers, international visitors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to independently prioritize multiple front office and administrative requirements.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and other standard Microsoft 365 applications**.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional correspondence skills.
* Strong attention to detail and record-keeping ability.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate discretion.
* Calm and composed approach when managing difficult visitors, complaints, emergencies, or unexpected situations.
* Good coordination and vendor-management skills.

title: Global Director of People and Culture
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

**How you’ll make an impact:**
------------------------------

Cin7 is an inventory management company with a globally distributed team and customers around the world. People are at the heart of what we do. As we keep growing, we need a hands-on HR leader who can partner closely with our Engineering and Product teams to build a high-performing, engaged culture.

You’ll be a trusted advisor to technology leaders, bringing HR expertise and a business perspective to how we hire, develop, reward, and retain talent. You’ll work across time zones with the Global People and Culture team to share ideas, practices, and projects that support our people and our goals. You will also lead a small team, providing day-to-day guidance, development, and performance support to your direct reports.

This is a director-level role with ownership of the people agenda for your teams. This role will have one direct report at launch: the HR Business Partner (New Zealand). You will also work with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) through a matrix reporting relationship. You’ll be based in Pune or Ahmedabad and will travel approximately quarterly to visit our teams in Ahmedabad/Pune, Colombo, and Dubai.

### **What you'll do:**

* Own and drive HR outcomes and deliverables that support the overall People and Culture vision and strategy.
* Serve as a trusted counsel to Engineering and Product leaders on people matters, including complex employee relations and performance issues.
* Lead global planning cycles such as compensation planning, goal setting, and performance reviews, coordinating closely with leaders to execute them.
* Lead HR projects such as restructuring, reorganizations, and merit cycles, guiding leaders on approach and timelines and supporting them through completion.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders to align HR initiatives with business strategy.
* Anticipate future capability needs and proactively address emerging people challenges.
* Champion Cin7’s values, culture, and employee engagement across your teams.
* Provide clear, accurate people data and analysis to inform decisions and communicate updates to leaders.
* Partner with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) and the HR Business Partner (New Zealand) to set priorities, share best practices, and support their work across the matrix.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR leader across multiple areas of HR ownership.
* Prior experience managing people leaders or HR team members, including across more than one country.
* Demonstrated expertise across HR functions, with experience practicing HR in a global or multi-region capacity.
* Experience leading through influence and working with virtual and global teams.
* Strong understanding of employment relations, performance management, and engagement practices.
* Financial acumen and strong business presentation skills.
* Ability to create frameworks for processes and best practices.
* Team mindset: you roll up your sleeves and help others.

### **Tools & Technology:**

* Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, including deep-dive employee data analysis and benchmarking.
* Experience with performance management systems.
* Confident, everyday use of AI tools to improve HR workflows, analysis, and communication.

### **In return, we offer:**

* Growth opportunities, a team and a support network.
* Flexible working
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* Social events and many opportunities to build your local, regional and global community
* Customer Volunteer Days
* Recruitment referral bonus

* A diverse and global team, where everyone helps solve problems.
* A culture that is owned by all of us

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Principal, Security Development & Automation
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Principal, Security Development & Automation is a senior technical contributor who helps protect Northern Trust by engineering automation-first security capabilities. This role is responsible for designing and delivering AI-enabled workflows, API integrations, playbooks, scripts and platform services that strengthen cyber defense, reduce manual operational burden and make security outcomes more consistent, measurable and repeatable. The Principal Partner works across security engineering, operations, infrastructure, application, risk, audit and technology teams to identify high-value security workflows, translate them into automation patterns and deliver solutions that improve control execution, threat response, vulnerability management, evidence collection and operational resilience.

**What You'll Do**

***Protect Northern Trust Through Security Driven Development and Automation***

* Build development and automation capabilities that help protect Northern Trust’s technology environment, reduce cyber risk and improve the consistency of security execution.
* Engineer AI agent-based workflows that support security triage, enrichment, correlation, investigation support, evidence collection, control validation and remediation orchestration.
* Create secure API integrations across security platforms, ITSM, CMDB, vulnerability management, cloud, network, identity, data and observability tools to connect signals, decisions and actions.
* Develop reliable workflow automation assets that remove friction from security operations and make high-value controls easier to operate at scale.
* Partner with security architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, IAM, threat and governance teams to create reusable automation standards, secure engineering patterns, guardrails and operational handoffs.

***Key Deliverables***

* Own development and automation capabilities that help Northern Trust protect critical services and data, including:

– Security workflow automation that accelerates discovery, response, remediation and control validation

– API integrations and reusable playbooks that connect security platforms, enterprise data sources and operational systems of record

– AI-enabled assistants and agents that improve security decision support while respecting enterprise controls, approvals and data protection requirements

– Design and Build LLM-based vulnerability scanning and remediation solutions.

* Integrate LLM capabilities responsibly using enterprise AI platforms such as AI Foundry, approved model providers and vendor AI harnesses to enhance—not replace—security judgment and control execution.
* Develop prompt, retrieval, orchestration, testing and evaluation patterns that make AI-enabled workflows reliable, observable, secure and aligned to enterprise policy.
* Engineer automation with strong authentication, authorization, secrets handling, logging, exception handling, change control and auditability so solutions can be trusted in production security workflows.
* Document architecture, runbooks, decision logic, reusable patterns and operational handoffs so capabilities can be supported, governed and improved over time.
* Influence platform roadmaps, vendor integrations and automation priorities based on risk reduction, control effectiveness, resiliency, stability and reuse.
* Mentor junior team members

**What You'll Bring**

* 15+ years of experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, security automation, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation or related technology disciplines.
* Strong understanding of how development and automation can be used to protect enterprise environments, improve control execution and reduce operational risk.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a principal-level technical partner: setting direction, influencing architecture, mentoring engineers, leading complex technical delivery and driving adoption across teams without relying on direct authority.
* Hands-on development skills in Python, including API consumption, data transformation, automation frameworks, error handling, testing and operational supportability.
* Experience integrating security, ITSM, cloud, identity, observability or data platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, workflow tools or orchestration platforms.
* Working knowledge of LLM-enabled solution patterns, AI agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI guardrails and secure use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Ability to deliver in a regulated environment with strong attention to audit-ready evidence, access controls, change management, testability, resiliency and production support.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services, banking, asset servicing, wealth management or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflows, Vulnerability Response, SecOps, CMDB, ITSM integrations or similar enterprise workflow platforms.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines or cloud-native automation patterns.
* Experience building automation for vulnerability management, exposure management, threat response, identity security, network security or cloud security operations.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Senior Director, People Operations
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Sr Director, People Operations (Shared Services)

  

**PTC | Pune, India | Global HR Shared Services | Hybrid**

  

Lead PTC’s global People Operations shared services from Pune, delivering accurate, compliant and effortless HR services to 7,000+ employees worldwide.

  

**About PTC**
-------------

PTC is a global software company whose CAD, PLM, ALM and SLM solutions help industrial companies design, make and service products. With more than 7,000 employees worldwide, we are building a connected, inclusive culture where people do their best work.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

As Sr Director, People Operations (Shared Services), you will own the engine room of the employee experience. You will lead the Pune-based team that delivers HR services from hire to retire to employees and managers in every region, and you will shape how PTC scales People operations through standardisation, automation and data. You will work closely with the global People leadership team, HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, IT, Finance and Legal.

  

**Function** : People Operations / Human Resources

  

**Location:** Pune, India (hybrid, per PTC workplace policy)

  

**Reports to** Global People leadership (VP / Chief People Officer organisation)

  

**Team:** Senior managers and managers across HR Service Delivery, HR Operations, HRIS and Data, and Mobility and Onboarding Operations

  

**Scope:** Global: Americas, EMEA and APAC

  

**Travel:** Occasional, about 10–15%

  

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Strategy and leadership**

* Define and execute the multi-year vision and roadmap for global People Operations shared services, aligned to PTC’s business and People strategy.

* Serve as the senior People leader at the Pune site, representing the function in global leadership forums and site governance.

* Build, coach and develop a high-performing, multi-layered team, and plan succession and capability across the function.

Design the operating model (tiered service, follow-the-sun coverage, in-house vs partner delivery) and the business case for changes to it.  

  

**Service delivery and operational excellence**

* Own end-to-end delivery of HR services across the employee lifecycle: onboarding, employee data changes, contracts and letters, mobility, leave and absence, offboarding and employment verification.

* Run a tiered service model (self-service, Tier 1/2 case handling, escalation to Centers of Excellence) with clear SLAs, KPIs and customer-satisfaction targets.

* Partner with Payroll, Benefits, Finance and external vendors to ensure accurate, on-time inputs and outputs across all countries.

Drive continuous improvement with Lean Six Sigma methods: remove root causes of repeat contacts, reduce cycle times and lower cost per employee served.  

  

**HR systems, data and automation**

* Co-own the HR technology roadmap (Workday HCM, case management and knowledge tooling) with People Technology and IT.

* Lead process standardisation, workflow automation and AI-enabled self-service to raise the share of issues resolved without an agent.

Safeguard data integrity and reporting quality, and deliver operational and workforce analytics to People leadership and the business.  

  

**Governance, risk and compliance**

* Ensure HR processes comply with employment law, data privacy (including GDPR and India’s DPDP Act), SOX and internal-audit requirements across regions.

* Maintain policies, procedures, controls and documentation; lead internal and external audits and close findings.

Manage vendor and BPO relationships, contracts, performance reviews and budgets.  

  

**Transformation and stakeholder partnership**

* Lead large global programs, including system implementations, M&A integration, new-country entry and organisational change, in partnership with HRBPs and Centers of Excellence.

* Build trusted relationships with global People leaders, regional HR heads and business leaders, and communicate performance and insights clearly.

Own the function’s budget, headcount plan and cost-to-serve targets.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in People Operations, including at least 8 years leading HR operations or shared services for a multinational, ideally in software, technology or another high-growth industry.

* 10+ years of progressive people management experience, with a proven record of leading large, multi-site and multi-country teams (50+ people, including managers of managers) delivering to global SLAs.

* Hands-on Workday experience (a must), with deep expertise in end-to-end HR processes and case management tools such as ServiceNow or Salesforce. SuccessFactors or Oracle exposure is a plus.

* Demonstrated success in process re-engineering, automation and digital transformation, with measurable gains in service quality, employee experience and cost.

* Strong working knowledge of global employment regulations, data privacy and controls (GDPR, India DPDP Act, SOX), including audit readiness.

* Experience managing vendors and outsourcing or BPO partners, including contracts, service credits and governance.

* Strong financial and analytical skills: budgeting, cost-to-serve modelling, dashboards and KPI-led management.

Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business or a related field, plus Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher.  

  

**Preferred**

* Postgraduate degree (MBA, or an MA in HR, Digital HR Transformation or People Analytics) or relevant certification (SHRM-SCP, SPHR, CIPD, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, ITIL or PMP).

* Experience standing up or scaling a global capability center or shared services centre in India.

* Hands-on exposure to AI, chatbots and employee self-service platforms in HR delivery.

* Experience supporting M&A integrations and new-entity set-ups.

Comfort working across time zones with stakeholders in North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  

  

**Skills and leadership strengths**

* **Metrics-led management:** sets measurable goals and tracks KPIs, SLAs and dashboards, because what gets measured gets improved.

* **Continuous improvement:** applies Lean Six Sigma to simplify HR processes, cut manual effort and reduce cost.

* **HR process automation:** automates high-volume HR operations while protecting data accuracy and compliance.

* **Digital HR transformation and People Analytics:** uses data and technology to improve decisions, service quality and the employee experience.

* **Employee-centric service design:** builds processes around end-user experience and satisfaction.

* **Building world-class delivery teams:** hires, coaches and empowers teams to deliver seamless HR services.

* **Complex project leadership:** steers multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs from scoping to results.

* **Culture of innovation, collaboration and inclusion:** empowers HR teams and the wider business to reach operational excellence.

* **Influence and change leadership:** engages executives, HR partners and employees with clarity across cultures, and brings people along through automation and new ways of working.

* **Integrity and accountability:** handles sensitive data and decisions with discretion and ownership.

  

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

In your first 12–18 months, success will be measured by: **rection**

  

**SLA attainment across HR service tiers**

Sustained at or above target

  

**Employee and manager satisfaction with HR services (CSAT / eNPS for services)**

Improving year on year

  

**Share of inquiries resolved through self-service or automation**

Increasing

  

**Cost per employee served and cost-to-serve**

Decreasing

  

**Data accuracy and audit outcomes**

No significant findings

  

**Team engagement, attrition and bench strength**

Healthy engagement, low regretted attrition

Targets will be agreed with the global People leadership team within your first 90 days.

  

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

PTC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will provide reasonable accommodations for candidates during the recruitment process on request.

Life at PTC is about more than the job: a collaborative, inclusive culture, a chance to shape how a global technology leader serves its people, and the opportunity to work with passionate colleagues around the world.

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."
