title: Learning & Development Data and Systems (Analyst)
description:
Type of contract

Full Time

Location

Pune (Delivery Platform), India

Service line

Human Resources

**Role:** Learning & Development Data and Systems (Analyst)

**Experience:** 3+ Years

**Location:** Pune

**Purpose of the Role**

The Learning & Development Data and Systems Analyst plays a pivotal role in enabling a controlled, insight led and scalable learning operation. The role has significant responsibility for the preparation, implementation and ongoing optimisation of the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring that learning workflows, data, reporting and governance protocols are embedded consistently across the firm.

The postholder acts as the central point of expertise for learning data, systems and reporting — supporting the wider Learning & Talent Development team and internal stakeholders with practical, system-based solutions that enable efficient delivery, regulatory compliance, cost control and high quality decision making.

In addition to system and data ownership, the role provides portfolio level operational insight across all L&TD provision, enabling the L&TD Operations Manager to maintain oversight of performance, risk and compliance across the full learning portfolio.

**Key Accountabilities**

LMS Implementation & Transformation

* Play a key role in the preparation for and implementation of the LMS, including requirements gathering, data preparation, testing, validation and go live support.
* Support the design, build and documentation of LMS workflows that enable efficient administration, tracking, evaluation and reporting of learning activity.
* Work closely with Learning Operations, Learning Design, Group Learning, IT and vendors to ensure LMS configuration aligns to agreed governance and operational requirements.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), defect management and post implementation review.
* Ensure that workflows and data reporting between the LMS and other systems is seamless and steps taken to resolve.

LMS Optimisation & Workflow Design

* Own the ongoing optimisation of the LMS post implementation, ensuring it continues to meet business, regulatory and operational needs.
* Build and maintain structured workflows within the LMS (e.g. enrolment, approvals, pathways, evaluations, exception handling).
* Act as a solutions partner to the wider L&TD team and internal stakeholders, using the LMS to resolve operational challenges rather than manual workarounds.
* Ensure system enhancements are controlled, documented and aligned to agreed ways of working.

Learning Data Management & Governance

* Own the integrity, structure and governance of learning data across systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency and audit readiness.
* Establish and maintain clear data definitions, rules and controls for learning data (e.g. mandatory training, attendance, completions, evaluations).
* Ensure data workflows and reporting outputs are aligned to governance protocols, audit requirements and internal controls.
* Maintain the process inventory and ongoing gap analysis, take remedial action where needed and report on progress.
* Provide controlled datasets and evidence trails to support internal and external audit activity (e.g. ISQM/SOQM).
* Maintain portfolio based evidence trails and datasets to support audit activity and regulatory assurance.
* Ensure data structures and reporting enable clear portfolio segmentation, rather than programme by programme visibility only.

Portfolio Intelligence & Risk Insight

* Maintain a portfolio level view of learning operations, using data to identify trends, imbalances or risk across provision.
* Provide early warning of compliance, capacity or delivery risks that may affect one or more portfolios.
* Support the Operations Manager with structured insight and recommendations, rather than raw data, to enable timely and informed decisions.

Reporting, Insights & Analytics

* Produce accurate, timely and meaningful learning reports for stakeholders across Learning & Talent Development, service lines and leadership.
* Deliver mandatory learning and compliance reporting, including tracking, exception reporting and escalation.
* Analyse trends, risks and performance indicators within learning data and translate these into clear insights and recommendations.
* Support the development of dashboards and automated reporting where appropriate.
* Produce portfolio level operational reporting, providing clear visibility of performance, compliance, delivery risk and trends across Early Careers, Professional Education, Talent Development and central programmes.
* Analyse learning data to identify cross portfolio risks, systemic issues or emerging pressure points, escalating insight to the Operations Manager with clear interpretation.
* Translate complex system data into decision ready insight, highlighting where intervention or prioritisation may be required at portfolio level.

  

Budget Reporting & Cost Control

* Monitor and report on learning budget spend, including costs associated with systems, programmes, vendors and delivery.
* Support the Learning Administration and Operations Manager with cost tracking, forecasting and variance analysis.
* Ensure learning spend data is accurate, transparent and supports effective cost control and decision making.
* Maintain clear links between learning activity, system data and financial reporting.

Evaluation & Impact Measurement

* Support the firm’s learning evaluation framework through robust data capture, reporting and analysis.
* Ensure evaluation data is structured, accessible and usable to inform continuous improvement and governance reporting.
* Work with Learning Design colleagues to provide data driven insight into programme effectiveness and impact.

Process Improvement & Documentation

* Identify inefficiencies, risks or manual workarounds in learning systems and data processes and propose system led improvements.
* Support the design, documentation and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) relating to learning data, systems and reporting.
* Contribute to operational resilience, scalability and business continuity through well designed systems and workflows.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

* Work closely with Learning Operations, Learning Design, Early Careers, Professional Education and Group Learning colleagues.
* Provide guidance and informal training to team members on LMS functionality, workflows and reporting.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for learning data and systems queries.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

Essential

* Proven experience in a data, systems or analytics role within Learning, HR or a similar professional services environment.
* Strong experience working with Learning Management Systems, including configuration, workflows and reporting.
* Experience supporting system implementation or significant system change.
* Strong data handling and reporting skills, with advanced Excel capability.
* Experience working within governance frameworks, controls or audit led environments.
* High attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Desirable

* Experience supporting LMS implementation or migration programmes.
* Experience in budget tracking, cost reporting or financial controls.
* Experience of reporting tools or dashboards (e.g. Power BI).
* Understanding of regulatory or mandatory training requirements within professional services or financial services.

  

**Key Behaviours & Ways of Working**

* Governance focused: prioritises control, accuracy and compliance.
* Solutions oriented: uses systems and data to solve problems sustainably.
* Detail driven, big picture aware: balances precision with operational impact.
* Collaborative: works effectively with UK based stakeholders and global colleagues.
* Change positive: comfortable operating in programmes of transformation.

**Success Measures**

The role will be successful when:

* The LMS is implemented effectively and embedded as the primary operational tool for learning delivery and governance.
* Learning data and workflows are consistent, controlled and audit ready.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility of compliance, performance and spend.
* Learning systems actively reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Budget spend is transparent, well reported and effectively controlled.

  

This job description is not exhaustive and provides an overview of the role. The postholder may be required to complete additional or different duties that are relevant to the job grade

description:

title: Senior ISIM Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM) Engineer to design, implement, and support identity governance and administration solutions using IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM) and IBM Security Verify Governance platforms. This role is responsible for automating identity lifecycle management, provisioning, access governance, and compliance controls across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will work closely with security, infrastructure, application, and business teams to deliver scalable identity management solutions that enhance security, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

  

* **Role: Senior ISIM Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, configure, and support IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM) and IBM Security Verify Governance solutions.
* Configure identities, organizational structures, services, provisioning policies, roles, workflows, and access governance controls.
* Implement Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes and automate identity lifecycle management activities.
* Develop and maintain provisioning adapters, connectors, and integrations with Active Directory, LDAP, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and HR systems.
* Create and enhance workflows, business rules, approval processes, scripts, and custom provisioning logic.
* Manage reconciliation processes, identity synchronization, entitlement management, and account governance controls.
* Troubleshoot provisioning failures, reconciliation issues, workflow errors, and platform-related incidents.
* Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and security stakeholders to onboard new applications and services.
* Support identity governance functions including access certifications, segregation of duties controls, policy enforcement, and audit requirements.
* Perform platform upgrades, patch management, performance optimization, and environment maintenance activities.
* Develop technical documentation, operational procedures, implementation guides, and support runbooks.
* Participate in testing, deployment, release management, and production transition activities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, automation, and operational efficiency.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), or Cybersecurity Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM), IBM Security Verify Governance, or related IBM Identity solutions.
* Deep understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, reconciliation, role management, and governance processes.
* Experience designing and implementing Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows and automated identity management solutions.
* Strong expertise in configuring provisioning adapters, services, workflows, policies, and identity governance controls.
* Experience integrating ISIM with Active Directory, LDAP directories, databases, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and HR systems.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, LDAP, SQL, XML, REST APIs, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance, and entitlement management concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting complex provisioning, reconciliation, workflow, and application onboarding issues.
* Familiarity with compliance and governance frameworks including SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, and access certification requirements.
* Experience with application onboarding, connector development, and custom integration implementations.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and provide technical leadership for IAM initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* IBM Security Verify Governance, IBM Security Identity Manager, CISSP, CISM, or related security certifications are advantageous.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers**

  

**"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."**

description:
**Company Description**

Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC) is internal solution partner for METRO, a €29.8 Billion international wholesaler with operations in 32 countries through 625 stores & a team of 91,000 people globally. Metro operates in a further 10 countries with its Food Service Distribution (FSD) business and it is thus active in a total of 34 countries.

MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. Website: https://www.metro-gsc.in  
Company Size: 600-650  
Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India  
Type: Privately Held  
Inception: 2011

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose**

The IT Infrastructure & Business Information Security Officer will be responsible for supporting and maintaining enterprise IT infrastructure operations while ensuring that information security requirements are implemented across the assigned business or organizational entity.

The role combines hands-on IT infrastructure expertise with business information security responsibilities, including security risk identification, vulnerability management, compliance monitoring, security policy implementation, and coordination with central Cybersecurity, IT Infrastructure, application, and business teams.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in managing IT infrastructure environments, with practical experience in IT security governance and the ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into actionable business and technical activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Infrastructure Management and Operations — Primary Responsibility**

* Manage and support enterprise IT infrastructure, ensuring availability, performance, stability, and operational continuity.
* Administer and support Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity and access management, and enterprise collaboration platforms, as applicable.
* Manage and coordinate server, desktop, laptop, network, and endpoint infrastructure operations.
* Support network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, switches, routers, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Coordinate server patching, operating system upgrades, software deployment, endpoint updates, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, system health, capacity, and performance; identify and resolve operational issues.
* Manage incidents, problems, and change management processes in accordance with IT service management practices.
* Work with internal IT teams, managed service providers, and external vendors to ensure timely resolution of infrastructure issues.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, asset inventories, configuration records, support procedures, and operational reports.
* Ensure appropriate access controls, privileged account management, system hardening, and secure infrastructure configuration.
* Support infrastructure audits and ensure compliance with internal IT standards and operational policies.

**Business Information Security Officer (BISO) Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary coordination point between business/IT infrastructure teams and the central Information Security or CISO organization.
* Support the implementation of corporate information security policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements.
* Identify and assess information security risks associated with infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, and business processes.
* Support business security risk assessments and coordinate risk treatment plans with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor compliance with corporate security requirements and applicable regulatory or industry standards.
* Coordinate with business owners and technical teams to ensure security requirements are understood, assigned, and implemented.
* Support security awareness activities and communicate relevant security requirements to IT and business stakeholders.
* Support internal and external security audits, evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking.
* Escalate significant security risks, unresolved findings, policy deviations, and overdue remediation activities to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support the assessment and approval workflow for security exceptions, ensuring documented risk acceptance by authorized stakeholders.
* Participate in security incident response activities and coordinate with the central Security Operations Center (SOC), IT teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning from an information security perspective.
* Promote a security-first culture while balancing business requirements and operational priorities.

* Support security reviews of infrastructure changes, new technologies, and third-party service arrangements.
* Ensure security exceptions and deviations are documented, reviewed, and approved through the established governance process.

**Experience Requirements**

* **Overall experience:** 10–12 years or more in IT, with the required infrastructure and security experience.
* **IT Infrastructure:** Approximately 10 years of hands-on experience in enterprise infrastructure operations, administration, support, or management.
* **IT Security / BISO:** minimum 2-3 years of experience supporting information security, IT risk management, security governance, compliance, or BISO-related activities.
* Experience working in a medium-to-large enterprise or a complex, multi-location IT environment.
* Experience coordinating with infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, service providers, and central security functions.
* Experience preparing operational reports, management dashboards, compliance evidence, and remediation tracking reports.

**Technical Skills and Competencies**

**IT Infrastructure**

* Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
* Endpoint and device management.
* Networking fundamentals, including LAN, WAN, VPN, firewalls, and wireless networks.
* Server and endpoint patch management.
* Backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Cloud infrastructure fundamentals, preferably Microsoft Azure or AWS.

**Information Security**

* Information security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).
* Security risk assessment and remediation tracking.
* Endpoint security and EDR platforms.
* Security incident coordination.
* Security control assessment and audit support.
* Security policies, standards, and exception management.
* Understanding of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and relevant organizational security requirements.

Candidates do not need to hold every certification. One or more relevant certifications would be advantageous.

 **Qualifications**

**Mandatory:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* Relevant professional experience in enterprise IT infrastructure management and IT security coordination.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience and recognized professional certifications may be considered in accordance with company policy.

**Experience:**

10+ years in IT Infrastructure and 2–3 years in IT Security / BISO responsibilities

**IT Infrastructure:**

* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate.
* Cisco CCNA or an equivalent networking certification.

**Information Security and Governance:**

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.

Job Title: HR Director, RIB India

Location: Nashik & Pune (regular presence on both locations)

Employment Type: full-time

Senior HR leadership for RIB India, with a special focus on the Product Organization

  

**Role Purpose**

RIB Software is transforming how it designs, develops and delivers construction software through an increasingly AI-enabled Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). India is a strategically important Product and Innovation hub within this transformation.

The Director of Human Resources, India is the senior HR leader responsible for developing and executing the India people strategy, with particular emphasis on enabling the Product Organization’s business, workforce and AI-transformation priorities as well as commercial growth of the RIB portfolio in the Indian Market.

Following the successful completion of Project Unlock (slump deal transferring R&D workforce from Winjit India legal entity to RIB India legal), the role will ensure that the integration foundations are converted into a sustainable, scalable and globally aligned operating model through Project Stabilize, to be known internally as Project Stability (in progress).

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**India People Strategy and Strategic HR Leadership**

* Develop and deliver an integrated India People Strategy aligned with RIB’s corporate strategy, Product Organization priorities and India growth ambitions.

* Act as senior HR adviser to the India leadership team and Product leaders, translating business priorities into measurable workforce, organization, talent and culture outcomes.

* Provide an India perspective to global HR strategies while ensuring local execution is aligned with RIB-wide standards.

* Balance strategic transformation with high-quality, compliant and employee-focused HR operations.

* Represent HR in India governance forums and cross-functional transformation programs.

  

**Project Stabilize and Post-Unlock Transformation**

  

* Serve as the senior HR owner for the HR workstream of Project Stabilize, converting the achievements of Project Unlock into stable business-as-usual HR processes, governance, and organizational practices.

o Complete the integration of RIB India into global HR processes, campaigns and standards.

o Maintain and further develop the India HR action plan, provide progress reporting and escalate material workforce or organizational risks.

o Ensure that policies, processes and governance mechanisms are understood, adopted and consistently applied, with clear ongoing ownership.

o Partner across Finance, Legal and Compliance, Product, IT, Administration and Travel on cross-functional matters affecting the workforce and employee experience.

  

**HR Governance, Policy and Operational Maturity**

  

* Maintain compliant, standardized and audit-ready HR processes aligned with Indian labor law and RIB governance requirements.

* Ensure clarity of HR ownership, approval authorities, decision rights and escalation routes.

* Maintain the India employee-policy framework and oversee employee relations, grievance handling, disciplinary processes and performance-improvement procedures.

* Partner with Legal and Compliance on policy development, labor-law requirements, compensation compliance and regulatory change.

* Strengthen HR data quality, reporting, documentation and controls while simplifying processes and improving manager and employee experience.

  

**AI-Enabled SDLC Workforce Transformation**

  

* Translate the AI-enabled SDLC roadmap into an India workforce and capability strategy.

* Assess how AI augmentation affects roles, competencies, team structures, career paths, and workforce composition.

* Partner with global HR business partners and Product leaders to define future role profiles and capability requirements across Product Management, Engineering, Quality and Security.

* Identify roles requiring reskilling, upskilling, redeployment, redesign or external recruitment.

* Build change and adoption plans that help employees and managers understand how work will evolve.

* Develop workforce measures covering capability readiness, adoption, and organizational impact.

  

**Strategic Workforce Planning and Organization Design**

  

* Lead workforce planning for RIB India with a specific focus on the Product Organization.

* Establish a workforce baseline covering capacity, skills, critical roles, succession exposure, location, and future demand.

* Translate Product roadmaps and SDLC transformation requirements into short- and medium-term workforce plans.

* Advise on organization structures, spans and layers, reporting relationships, team composition and decision rights.

* Determine whether capability gaps should be addressed through development, internal mobility, recruitment, redeployment, or organizational redesign.

* Integrate location and office-capacity decisions with workforce planning.

  

**Talent Acquisition and AI-Led Hiring**

  

* Own the India Talent Acquisition strategy in partnership with the global TA organization.

* Build sustainable pipelines for software engineering, architecture, security, quality, product management, AI, and other critical capabilities.

* Shift recruitment from predominantly capacity-based hiring toward capability, experience, innovation potential, and future workforce requirements.

* Ensure Product requisitions reflect the appropriate job architecture, capability profile and AI-fluency expectations.

* Strengthen hiring-manager capability, selection quality, candidate experience, time to hire and time to productivity.

* Create corrective sourcing, location or role-design actions for critical or long-standing vacancies.

  

**7. Workforce Development and Future Skills**

  

* Build an India workforce-development roadmap aligned with the AI-enabled SDLC strategy.

* Identify technical, product, leadership and behavioral capabilities required for the future organization.

* Establish targeted reskilling and upskilling pathways, including AI-fluency learning journeys appropriate to different roles.

* Strengthen product, engineering and people-leadership capability through practical development interventions.

* Create internal mobility and career pathways that retain strong employees while addressing future capability needs.

* Link development priorities to talent reviews, succession plans and performance-development conversations.

  

**Change Management and Transformation Adoption**

  

* Lead the people-change strategy for major organizational and technology transformations in India.

* Conduct stakeholder, organizational-impact, and change-readiness assessments.

* Build clear change narratives explaining the business rationale, workforce implications, and expected employee behaviors.

* Equip leaders and managers to communicate and implement change effectively.

* Establish listening and feedback mechanisms and coordinate communications, training, manager enablement and employee support.

* Ensure sensitive workforce changes are managed fairly, consistently and in line with Indian employment requirements.

  

**Talent, Leadership and Succession**

  

* Establish a structured India talent-review and succession-planning cycle.

* Identify critical roles, high-potential talent, capability risks and leadership-pipeline gaps.

* Develop succession coverage for key Product, technical, and functional roles.

* Strengthen manager capability in performance, development, feedback, employee relations and organizational change.

* Create development plans for employees whose roles may be materially affected by the SDLC transformation.

  

**Employee Experience, Engagement and Culture**

  

* Build an employee experience that supports performance, learning, inclusion and retention.

* Champion RIB’s values and strengthen employee communication and trust during transformation.

* Use engagement insights and employee feedback to identify and address organizational issues.

* Develop targeted retention strategies for critical skills and key talent segments.

* Partner with leadership on the future working approach for Nashik and Pune, taking into account of collaboration, employee experience, talent availability, and capacity requirements.

  

**Key Deliverables**

  

* An integrated RIB India People Strategy.

* A clear transition plan from Project Stabilize into sustainable business-as-usual ownership.

* A Product Organization workforce plan aligned with the AI-enabled SDLC roadmap.

* A prioritized reskilling, upskilling and talent acquisition plan.

* A critical-role and succession map for RIB India.

* An organizational change and communication plan for the SDLC transformation.

* A mature India HR governance and policy framework.

* A data-driven Talent Acquisition strategy for critical and scarce capabilities.

* Defined success measures covering operational maturity, workforce readiness, recruitment, development, engagement and change adoption.

  

**Experience and Qualifications**

  

* Significant progressive HR leadership experience in India.

* Senior HR business-partnering experience within software, technology, product development, engineering or a comparable knowledge-based environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading organizational transformation and complex change.

* Strong expertise in strategic workforce planning, organization design, talent acquisition and workforce development.

* Experience working with Product, Engineering or Research and Development, and Sales leaders.

* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law (Maharashtra focus), employee relations, HR governance and compliance.

* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization.

* Strong program-management, analytical and cross-functional stakeholder-management capability.

* Ability to translate business and technology strategies into practical people and organization plans.

  

**Preferred**

  

* Experience supporting an AI, digital, cloud or software-development transformation.

* Working understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery and product operating models.

* Experience developing technology talent markets and capability pipelines in India.

* Experience integrating acquired, transferred or previously separate employee populations.

* Experience moving a significant transformation program from implementation into stable business-as-usual operation.

* Familiarity with Workday or a comparable global HR platform.

* Leadership Capabilities

  

**Strategic business and Product acumen**

  

* Transformation and change leadership

* Technology and AI curiosity

* Workforce and organization-design capability

* Commercial judgment

* Data-driven decision-making

* Executive stakeholder management

* Cross-cultural collaboration

* Constructive challenge

* High integrity and sound judgment

* Employee and customer orientation

* Execution through complexity and ambiguity

  

**Success Measures**

  

* Sustainable transition of Stabilize actions into clearly owned business-as-usual processes.

* Completion and effective adoption of outstanding India HR policies and governance mechanisms.

* Demonstrable workforce readiness for the AI-enabled SDLC transformation.

* Defined organization and capability plans for affected Product teams.

* Improved pipelines for critical Product and technology roles.

* Effective integration of AI fluency into hiring, development, and talent decisions.

* Increased internal development and mobility into priority capabilities.

* Stronger succession coverage for critical India roles.

* Improved manager capability and employee understanding during transformation.

* Reliable HR data, controls, compliance and audit readiness.

* Improved employee experience and retention in critical talent populations.

* Clear alignment between the India workforce agenda and the Global Product Organization strategy.

  
  

People at RIB

We’re focused on the single most important part of RIB's business: our employees. From recruitment and reward to experience and engagement, our partnerships across the business create and enable the conditions for every individual to thrive.

  

Doing the best we can for our great people requires quick thinking – and big thinking. Our team is as involved in the day-to-day activities affecting the employee experience as we are in the global transformation projects shaping RIB’s future. Join us and become part of a diverse and vibrant group that’s striving to make every day at RIBeven better than the last.

  
  

RIB may require all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

RIB is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

Come and join RIB to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to build a better world.

description:
Job Title: **Executive Assistant to Managing Director**  
Location: Pune  
Employment Type: Full-Time  
Experience Level: 8 - 12 Years  
Working Hours: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM  
Working Days: 6 Days

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced, high-ownership, and strategically minded Executive Assistant to Managing Director (EA to MD) with 8 to 12 years of multi-functional experience. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner and force multiplier to senior leadership. You will bridge strategy and execution across key business verticals—including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, HR, and Customer Experience. Beyond executive operations, you will actively own and drive digital marketing strategies, content creation, brand positioning, and cross-functional growth projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy

Lead and oversee digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, SEO/SEM, and influencer networks to drive D2C customer acquisition and retain subscription users. Partner with growth teams and agencies to optimize Performance Marketing spend, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). Direct email marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Business automation, push notifications, and app-based loyalty/retention workflows.

* Content Writing & Strategic Communication

Draft compelling copy for website, mobile app landing pages, product announcements, email newsletters, and promotional messaging. Own corporate communications, founder branding content (LinkedIn posts, industry thought leadership, media releases), and internal newsletter communications. Review, refine, and maintain brand voice across all digital touchpoints, customer communication channels, and packaging/collateral copy.

* Strategic Business Operations & Cross-Functional Governance

Act as a key strategic liaison between the Founder/Leadership and department heads (Logistics, Sales, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, HR) to align project deliverables and monitor operational workflows. Track company-wide OKRs/KPIs, ensure accountability across business units, and follow up proactively on critical corporate initiatives and milestone deliverables. Lead high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, market expansion studies, product launch readiness reviews, and process optimization initiatives.

title: Senior Associate, Software License Management | Flexera One (Two Positions)
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Software License Management Analyst**

Software License Management (SLM) is responsible for managing the license positions of NT hardware and software that support business strategic goals.

The Software License Management Analyst participates in the lifecycle of software entitlements management including active license tracking and financial baseline and forecasting of software products. The role will utilize a combination of products and tools including the initial software entitlements for a portfolio of vendors utilizing Flexera One for entitlements mapping/utilization as well as engaging with a managed service partner. The role will also participate in support of the Flexera One platform and ensuring complete and accurate software inventory and related data.

**The key responsibilities of the role include:**

**Software License Management**

* Engage with Entitlements Analysts to understand stakeholder software demand. This includes:

1. Understanding existing entitlements and cost for portfolio of software publisher products

2. Determining growth or decline projections based on engagement with software product owners/stakeholders

* Track and report on current and future volumes/obligations for designated portfolio of software products
* Establish regular cadence (monthly/quarterly) to provide reporting to management and stakeholders
* Participate in the continuous improvement of systematic controls for software demand management

**SLM Tool Support**

* Conduct health checks of the Flexera One configurations and ensure operational effectiveness
* Enable and maintain Flexera integrations and APIs
* Support Flexera platform testing relative to Infrastructure change activities
* Participate in the continuous improvement of systematic controls for software asset management
* Maintain and manage inventory of Flexera FlexNet agents including lifecycle updates
* Maintain and manage Flexera beacon operational effectiveness
* Ensure data quality software asset inventory

**Other duties include:**

* Planning work in conjunction with IT and business priorities
* Liaising with partners and peers throughout the organization

**The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience with the following:**

* Business analysis
* 6 to 9 years of relevant experience
* Financial acumen to determine and represent adequate forecasting and accruals for software entitlements
* Excellent communication skills, verbal, written and presentational. Will work with end users in a time sensitive environment.
* Experience in Procurement and/or Finance organizations partnering with Technology and business software product owners/stakeholders is a plus
* Self-starter, and be able to think ahead of entitlements related nuances
* Software demand and lifecycle management for commercial software products is a plus
* Experience with the Flexera One platform ITAM module
* Additional Flexera One module experience is a plus

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Head of HR
description:
**Location -** Pune, Maharashtra, India.

**About EDMO:**

EDMO is an AI-powered company that provides enrollment-centric solutions to universities, colleges, and higher education institutions. By streamlining repetitive tasks—such as document verification, transcript evaluation, SOP/essay reviews, and applicant matching—EDMO enables its clients to process student applications faster and more accurately. Its intelligent workflows not only reduce administrative workload but also empower admission advisors to focus on personalized guidance and student engagement.

With features like AI-powered chatbots, Photo ID verification, GPA calculator, and transfer credit evaluation, EDMO ensures transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Institutions using EDMO services report significant time savings, improved decision-making, and enhanced student satisfaction.

At its core, EDMO is built to reimagine & streamline admissions—making them smarter, quicker, and more human-centric.

### **Website:**

https://goedmo.com

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Head of HR to build and lead the people function at EDMO. As we scale rapidly at the intersection of AI and higher education, this role is critical in shaping our culture, attracting top talent, and building the organisational capabilities needed to support our growth. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership role, and a proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

**Reporting to :** CEO

**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive the end-to-end HR strategy encompassing talent acquisition, performance management, learning & development, compensation, and employee engagement.
* Partner closely with the CEO and senior leadership to align people strategy with business goals and organisational priorities.
* Build and scale HR processes, policies, and frameworks, ensuring compliance with Indian and US labour laws and employment regulations.
* Lead talent acquisition efforts to attract and retain high-calibre professionals across product, engineering, AI, and business functions.
* Design and implement performance management systems, career development frameworks, and succession planning processes.
* Champion a strong, inclusive, and high-performance culture that reflects EDMO's values.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives, pulse surveys, and retention strategies to maintain a motivated and committed workforce.
* Oversee onboarding, offboarding, and the overall employee lifecycle experience to ensure consistency and quality at every touchpoint.
* Manage HR operations including payroll coordination, HRIS systems, and HR analytics to enable data-driven people decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and leaders on people matters, conflict resolution, and organisational development.

* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or Head of HR role.
* Prior experience in a startup, SaaS, or technology company is strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, HR compliance, and statutory requirements.
* Proven ability to build HR functions and processes in a scaling organisation.
* Experience across the full HR spectrum — talent acquisition, L&D, compensation & benefits, performance management, and HR operations.
* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging HR analytics and HRIS platforms.

* Experience supporting a globally distributed or cross-border team (India + US).

* Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a variety of perks.
* A collaborative, fast-moving team that values people, impact, and continuous growth.

We are seeking an experienced **Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer** to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.

This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.

The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. * Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.

* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.

* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.

* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.

title: Director, Product Management - Learning
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Product Management - Learning**
===========================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning | Pune |**
  
  
**About Cornerstone**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In This Role You Will**

**Set vision & strategy**
  
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
  
Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
  
Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
  
Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.
  
**Lead & grow the team**
  
Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
  
Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
  
Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.
  
**Discover, experiment & measure**
  
Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
  
Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
  
Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
  
Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.
  
**Deliver with rigor**  
Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
  
Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
  
Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
  
Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
  
  
A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
  
A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
  
Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, and measurable business outcomes.
  
Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
  
AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
  
Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.
  
  
**You have Got What it takes If you Have**
  
  
10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
  
A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
  
Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
  
Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
  
Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
  
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
  
Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.
  
  
**Nice to Have**  
  
Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
  
Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
  
Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.

title: Senior Specialist Business Consultant (Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation)
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation (SPARK)**
=========================================================

SPARK | CX International Internal Incubation Team | Location: Pune

**So, what's the role all about?**
----------------------------------

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. A tool only creates value if people use it, so we need a change leader who can make AI feel useful, safe, and exciting.

As Change Management & Evangelist, you will lead the people side of everything SPARK delivers - preparing teams for change, building AI confidence and skills, and creating the energy that turns a new tool into a new habit. You bring a consulting background, so you know how to diagnose, structure, influence, and deliver, and how to tell a story that moves senior leaders and front-line teams alike.

You will be a visible champion of AI for CX International. You will demo, teach, listen, and bring what you hear back to the builders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the Business Analyst, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Support Helpdesk, Field Sales Enablement team, HR Business Partners.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own adoption for every SPARK solution, from the first conversation with the business through to sustained use at scale and be the voice of SPARK across the organization.

### **Plan and Lead Change**

  

* Assess change impact and readiness for each solution, and map stakeholders, concerns, and the behaviours that need to shift
* Serve as the primary **on-the-ground team leader** for SPARK initiatives, providing hands-on support throughout rollout and adoption phases.
* Build and run change, communications, and rollout plans for each global launch, tailored to regions, roles, and time zones
* Work with the Project Manager so change milestones sit inside the delivery plan, not after it
* Address resistance and concerns openly, including questions about roles and job security, with honest and consistent messages

### **Build AI Fluency and Skills**

* Design and deliver role-based training, workshops, office hours, and self-paced content that teach people to use SPARK solutions in their own workflow
* Create and maintain the SPARK playbook: guides, templates, FAQs, and good-practice examples
* Promote responsible and secure use of AI, in line with company guidance
* Be in constant engagement with key stakeholders and users to identify engagement roadmap

### **Be the Evangelist**

* Tell the SPARK story through demos, showcases, town halls, and internal roadshows that show what is possible and what is already working
* Build and run a network of AI champions across business units who help their peers adopt new tools and share what works
* Collect ideas from across the organisation and encourage colleagues to bring them to SPARK
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leaders on how to lead their teams through AI-enabled change
* Draft and send communications as required for CX International, ELT as project sponsor working with NiCE Comms team and HR.

### **Measure and Improve Adoption**

* Define adoption and value measures: active use, depth of use, sentiment, behavior change, and benefits realized
* Run feedback loops with users, the Support Helpdesk, and the architects, turning recurring issues and requests into improvements
* Report adoption progress and lessons learned to sponsors, CX International Senior Leadership and steering committees

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, Organisational Development, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 12-18 years of experience in change management, transformation, or enablement, including a background in management or technology consulting
* Proven record of leading change for technology rollouts and shifts in ways of working, across multiple regions or business units
* Strong knowledge of structured change approaches such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter certification, or equivalent
* Excellent storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills, including with senior executives
* Experience designing and delivering training and enablement programs for non-technical audiences
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and a practical sense of what they can and cannot do
* Experience in using Notebook LLM, Synthesia, Beautiful.ai or equivalent.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority, and to use data to show progress
* Fluency in English

### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience in software, SaaS, or technology companies or working for consulting company
* Agentic AI adoption project outside of India is a plus
* Experience running AI or digital champion networks
* Prosci ADKAR or an equivalent change management certification
* Instructional design or learning and development experience
* Experience speaking at internal or external events
* Experience working with teams across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
--------------------

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

**Reporting into:** Jean Lee , Vice President, Business Operations. Sales Ops

(NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

DNV utilizes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud across several HR processes, together with related PaaS services and other integrated HR solutions. For this position, we are particularly looking for strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), combined with broader hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion HCM.

The position combines application management, functional and technical consulting, configuration, integrations, operational support and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute both to stable day-to-day operations and to initiatives further developing our global HR technology landscape.
  
Be part of our long-term journey to continuously develop and improve the global HR IT landscape at DNV.

* Provide functional and technical application support, including analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex application issues.

* Execute and manage configuration enhancements and technical changes based on new or evolving business requirements.
* Contribute to Oracle Fusion HCM release management, including impact assessment, regression testing and review of relevant release documentation.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of solutions and services within the broader GSS IT application environment and DNV system landscape.
* Maintain appropriate functional and technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the HR Applications team.

**Why this role matters**

Our HR application landscape supports critical HR processes globally. As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will contribute directly to the stability, development and continuous improvement of these solutions.

You will work at the intersection of HR processes, Oracle Fusion HCM and technology, helping translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting the continued evolution of DNV’s global HR technology landscape.

Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Must have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, including application configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), including configuration and integrations with other systems.
* Hands-on experience with additional Oracle Fusion HCM areas such as Core HR, Compensation,
* Benefits, Security, Talent or other HCM modules.

* Experience with SQL for analysis and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of end-to-end HR business processes and their implementation within HR technology solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  Personal qualities

* Is self-driven, proactive and well organized.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Has a hands-on and pragmatic approach to problem solving.
* Is comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a global team.
* Is customer and business oriented and able to understand HR needs beyond purely technical requirements.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

### **Job Title**

HR Service Agent

### **Job Description**

**HR Service Agent | Pune, India | Full-time**

If you are passionate about delivering an excellent employee experience, resolving HR queries, and continuously improving HR service delivery in a global organization, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.

**Your Role**

As an HR Service Agent, you will be part of Vanderlande’s Global HR Service Desk within the Regional HR & Services organization, based in Pune, India. You will report to the Regional HR Service Desk Lead APAC. Vanderlande’s Global HR organization comprises four main areas: Business HR, Reward & Mobility, Talent Acquisition & Learning, and Regional HR & Services. The Regional HR & Services team provides local HR expertise while also supporting global HR service delivery through the Global HR Service Desk and Global HR Specialists team. As part of a team of nine HR Service Agents, you will serve as the first point of contact for employees based in the Netherlands. You will resolve first-line HR queries relating to policies, processes, and systems, execute basic HR transactions, and guide employees and managers in using employee and manager self-service tools. You will play a key role in delivering an efficient, consistent, and positive employee experience, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Do**

HR Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

* Deliver a seamless and consistent employee experience while maintaining service efficiency and quality.
* Resolve first-line employee queries related to HR policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex cases to the relevant specialists when required.
* Record and document employee inquiries using the ticketing and case management system.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets by providing accurate, consistent, and timely support.
* Execute back-office HR processes and transactions in accordance with established policies and standard operating procedures.
* Conduct the necessary research to investigate queries and support effective resolution.
* Guide employees and managers through self-service transactions, HR portal navigation, and HR policy interpretation to encourage independent resolution.
* Use data and service insights to monitor performance, identify trends, and improve the employee experience.
* Support ad hoc projects and activities within the Regional HR & Services organization.

Continuous Improvement

* Collaborate with Regional HR & Services stakeholders to understand, implement, and improve HR processes, with a focus on employee experience and employee life events.
* Identify recurring service issues and proactively recommend improvements.
* Lead or support the implementation of process and service delivery enhancements.
* Drive local improvements in collaboration with HR stakeholders and other relevant teams.

**What You Bring**

* At least 3 years of experience in first-line HR support.
* A good understanding of local HR policies and procedures is desirable.
* A data-driven approach with the ability to use information and insights to support effective service delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Experience with Workday or another HR information system is an advantage.
* Proficiency in English is essential.

**About Vanderlande**

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

**Website:** www.vanderlande.com

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary package.
* 30 days of annual leave, pro-rated from the start of the financial year, including:
  + 22 paid leave days.
  + 8 sick/casual leave days.
  + Applicable government holidays.
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives.
* The opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across the globe.

**How We Work**

We work by three values: Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.

**Ready to Apply?**

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Vanderlande, we believe that innovation and success come from bringing together people with different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute, develop and grow. We welcome talent from all backgrounds and recognise that there is no single path to success. We are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout the recruitment process and beyond. * Support end-to-end recruitment activities, from receiving approved manpower requisitions to candidate onboarding.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, recruitment databases, and other relevant channels.
* Screen resumes against job descriptions and shortlist suitable candidates based on qualifications, experience, skills, and salary expectations.
* Maintain a pipeline of suitable candidates for current and anticipated manpower requirements.
* Follow up with recruitment consultants and staffing agencies wherever required.
  

  

**B. Interview Coordination & Follow-up**

* Coordinate interview schedules with candidates, HR, and hiring managers.

* Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding subsequent interview rounds, salary discussions, offers, and joining dates.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates to minimize dropouts and offer declines.

* Create and maintain job postings on Naukri and the company’s HRMS.
* Ensure recruitment activities and candidate details are updated accurately in the HRMS and recruitment trackers.

* Maintain proper documentation of approved requisitions, candidate evaluations, and recruitment-related records.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About GSS**

  
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.

### **About the role**

**DNV’s HR Applications** team manages and supports the global technology landscape behind our HR processes. Our portfolio includes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud and a range of other HR applications, supporting employees, managers and HR communities across DNV. The team is responsible for keeping these solutions stable and effective while continuously improving and developing the HR technology landscape.

We are looking for two **Oracle Fusion HCM & HR Applications Support Leads** to strengthen the leadership of our global HR Applications organization. The roles will lead two complementary functional streams: HR Foundation (Core HR) and Talent & Experience.

These are hands-on leadership roles combining people leadership, service ownership and strong functional and technical involvement. As a Lead, you will stay close to the technology and day-to-day operations, supporting the team on complex topics while helping drive improvements and further development of our HR solutions.

The two Leads will work closely together across the HR application landscape, collaborating with HR stakeholders, IT teams and external partners to ensure reliable services and an effective end-to-end experience. The environment includes operational support, application enhancements and HR technology projects, providing the opportunity to influence both how we operate today and how our HR technology landscape develops going forward.

* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

We are looking for Leads who combine strong technical credibility with a genuine passion for people development. You will be expected not only to provide technical direction and support on complex topics, but also to coach, challenge and empower team members to grow their expertise and take greater ownership.

* Experience leading, coaching and developing a team, preferably in an international environment.
* Over 10 years of relevant experience
* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud and/or other enterprise HR applications.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.

**Broader experience across multiple Oracle Fusion HCM modules and other HR applications will be considered a strong advantage.**
