title: Senior Total Rewards Specialist
description:
**Senior Total Rewards Specialist**

**Location: Pune, India (Work from home)**

  

**Role Overview**

Convera is seeking a Senior Total Rewards Specialist to support and enhance our global Total Rewards programs through a combination of benefits administration, compensation support, and employee engagement initiatives. Reporting into the Total Rewards team, you will play a key role in the day-to-day management of international benefits programs, global leave processes, vendor relationships, invoicing, and compensation activities.

You will also contribute to the design and implementation of benefits, retirement, wellbeing, and compensation initiatives, including market benchmarking, pay analysis, and annual compensation cycles. This is a broad, hands-on role split between compensation and benefits. You will support the development and application of Total Rewards frameworks, analyse data, coordinate core processes, and make practical recommendations for review by senior members of the team. As part of a global function, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate program effectiveness, ensure compliance, improve processes, and increase employee awareness and engagement with our Total Rewards offerings.

  

**You will be responsible for:**

**Compensation**

* Supporting compensation processes and projects, including market benchmarking, pay range analysis, annual compensation planning, and the preparation of materials to inform reward decisions.
* Conducting market pricing and benchmarking using compensation survey data and established internal methodologies.
* Supporting participation in external compensation surveys and maintaining accurate market benchmark information.
* Analysing employee pay, salary ranges, compa-ratios, range position, internal equity, and market competitiveness to identify trends and exceptions.
* Supporting annual compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, salary adjustments, and incentive planning.
* Preparing compensation reports, models, and presentation materials to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Conducting job matching, job evaluation, and job grading activities using established methodologies, preparing recommendations, supporting governance reviews as required, and escalating complex or unusual cases for review.
* Partnering with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Finance to respond to compensation queries and provide data-based guidance within established frameworks.
* Maintaining compensation documentation, process guides, pay ranges, and supporting controls to promote accurate and consistent application.
* Contributing data and analysis to pay equity, pay transparency, and regulatory reporting projects.

**Benefits, Wellbeing & Leave**

* Managing and overseeing the day-to-day operations of international benefits programs.
* Playing a key role in the design and implementation of benefits, retirement, and wellbeing initiatives that reflect company values and address employees' needs at every stage of life.
* Managing global leave of absence programs, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and clear communication with stakeholders.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with vendors, brokers, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulations and company policies.
* Supporting benefit renewals, market reviews, implementations, and plan changes by coordinating data, timelines, testing, and stakeholder actions.
* Leading project plans and timelines for the implementation of programs and plan design enhancements.
* Utilising analytical skills to evaluate program utilisation, cost, employee feedback, and market practice, identifying trends and recommending practical improvements.
* Developing and delivering organisation-wide communications to inform employees and stakeholders about program updates and changes.
* Managing benefits invoicing and payment processes, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Maintaining benefits documentation, provider information, process guides, and employee-facing materials to support accurate and consistent delivery.

**Shared Total Rewards Delivery**

* Coordinating and delivering Total Rewards projects and workstreams from planning through implementation, including developing project plans, coordinating stakeholders, tracking actions, identifying risks and dependencies, and monitoring delivery against agreed timelines.
* Partnering with HR Business Partners to deliver Total Rewards initiatives, gathering and incorporating their business and employee insights to help shape practical, relevant, and scalable solutions.
* Responding to employee and stakeholder queries, resolving routine issues independently and escalating complex matters appropriately.
* Ensuring compensation and benefits data is accurate, confidential, and handled in line with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Identifying opportunities to simplify, document, and improve Total Rewards processes and employee experience.
* Collaborating with HR, Finance, Payroll, Legal, Procurement, and external partners to deliver accurate and timely outcomes.
* Keeping abreast of legislative and regulatory changes, and delivering changes to programmes to maintain compliance.

  

**You should apply if you have:**

* Relevant experience in a compensation, benefits, or broader Total Rewards role, with practical exposure to both compensation and benefits activities.
* Working knowledge of compensation principles, including market benchmarking, salary ranges, pay positioning, internal equity, and annual compensation cycles.
* Experience supporting employee benefits programs, renewals, vendors, communications, or administration, ideally across more than one country.
* Strong analytical and numerical capability, with the ability to interpret data, identify issues, and present clear findings.
* Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large or detailed datasets.
* Experience using compensation survey data from providers such as Aon, Mercer, WTW, Korn Ferry, or similar is desirable.
* Strong project management skills, with experience developing plans, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, tracking actions, and identifying risks or dependencies.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring processes, deadlines, and multiple priorities accurately.
* Practical experience of job evaluation, job grading, job matching, or role levelling using an established methodology or framework.
* Ability to build effective partnerships with HR Business Partners, translate their input into Total Rewards requirements, and support the delivery of initiatives that respond to business and employee needs.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work effectively with employees, HR colleagues, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* A practical, collaborative approach, with sound judgement about when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it.
* Experience working in an international, financial services, fintech, technology, or fast-paced environment is desirable.

  

**About Convera**

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs. Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, result-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

**We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:**

* Competitive salary
* Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.
* Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
* A flexible approach to work

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you're ready to unleash your potential.

title: Sr Lead, Infra End User Computing
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Position : Sr Lead, Infra EUC  
  
The Sr.Lead Engineer, End User Computing is a senior technical role responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving secure, resilient and user-centered endpoint services. The role supports Windows, macOS, mobile, browser, application-delivery and virtual workspace capabilities across a global, regulated enterprise. It combines hands-on engineering with architecture, automation, security, governance, documentation and technical leadership.

The engineer will support the current hybrid environment while advancing the EUC roadmap toward Intune-centered governance, cloud-managed provisioning and servicing, modern application delivery, intelligent automation, unified reporting, stronger lifecycle controls and reduced reliance on legacy infrastructure and scripting.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

* Design and implement enterprise endpoint solutions across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Cloud PC, virtual workspaces and supported device-ownership models.
* Engineer and maintain Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, Windows Update for Business, Jamf, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy and related services.
* Define target-state architectures, configuration baselines, deployment patterns, technical standards, test criteria, support models and operational acceptance requirements.
* Lead device provisioning, enrollment, configuration, patching, operating-system upgrades, driver and firmware servicing, recovery, retirement and lifecycle cleanup.
* Develop deployment-ring strategies, controlled pilots, success criteria, rollback plans, exception processes and evidence requirements for enterprise changes.
* Translate security, risk, audit and regulatory requirements into enforceable endpoint controls, monitoring, remediation and audit-ready evidence.
* Engineer capabilities supporting device compliance, encryption, least privilege, endpoint hardening, certificates, trust stores, application control, secure administration and vulnerability remediation.
* Develop secure and supportable automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, proactive remediations and approved workflow tools.
* Replace fragile or legacy scripts with version-controlled solutions that include logging, error handling, peer review, least privilege and safe rollback.
* Build endpoint-health monitoring, compliance reporting, deployment telemetry, failure analysis and operational dashboards that improve decision-making.
* Modernize application intake, packaging, certification, deployment, patching, retirement and self-service delivery through Intune-first and automation-led practices.
* Engineer and govern enterprise browser policies, extensions, standards, lifecycle controls and controlled exceptions across Microsoft Edge, Chrome and Safari.
* Support legacy dependency remediation, including IE Mode, embedded-browser, URL, script, certificate and application compatibility dependencies.
* Produce complete engineering documentation, including requirements, designs, implementation plans, test plans, runbooks, RACI assignments, support procedures, evidence and decision records.
* Ensure production readiness through monitoring, knowledge transfer, support ownership, recovery procedures, lifecycle plans and measurable service objectives.
* Act as a technical authority and escalation point for complex endpoint issues, high-severity vulnerabilities, major changes and transformation initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and coordinate delivery across Security, Architecture, IAM, Network, Cloud, VDI, Service Desk, application teams, vendors and managed-service partners.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 12 or more years of progressive infrastructure or EUC engineering experience, including ownership of complex enterprise implementations.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager/SCCM in co-managed, hybrid or migration environments.
* Strong knowledge of Windows endpoint architecture, provisioning, servicing, policy, security, application deployment and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of macOS and mobile management using Jamf and/or Intune MDM/MAM, Apple Business Manager and platform compliance capabilities.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, Conditional Access dependencies, modern authentication, certificates and PKI concepts.
* Hands-on automation experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, plus familiarity with source control and structured release practices.
* Experience with application packaging and deployment technologies such as Win32 applications, MSI and MSIX, including detection, requirements, dependencies and supersedence.
* Knowledge of endpoint security technologies and concepts including Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, LAPS, Windows Hello for Business, application control and attack-surface reduction.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident and problem management, configuration management and production support in a regulated enterprise.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
========================

* Engineering endpoint services at global scale across multiple regions, business units and device types.
* Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, Company Portal, Cloud Management Gateway, tenant attach, Cloud PC or virtual desktop integration.
* Browser governance, Chrome Enterprise Core, enterprise site lists, extension controls and legacy-browser dependency remediation.
* Application packaging automation, test automation, digital employee experience, proactive remediation or self-healing workflows.
* ServiceNow, Power BI, Azure DevOps or comparable workflow, backlog, reporting and portfolio-management platforms.
* Cryptographic inventory, certificate and trust dependency management, crypto-agility or post-quantum readiness planning.
* Relevant Microsoft, Azure, security, Apple/Jamf or ITIL certifications.

**PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES**
=============================

* End-to-end ownership, sound risk judgment and ability to drive work from requirements through stable operational handoff.
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to assess impacts across identity, network, security, applications, support and user experience.
* Disciplined engineering practices including standards, reusable patterns, testing, peer review, documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to engineers, partners and senior leaders.
* Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries while maintaining clear accountability, decision rights and delivery commitments.
* Continuous-improvement mindset focused on eliminating recurring issues, automating repetitive work and reducing technical debt.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**

OpenGov is seeking a Director, HR to lead our HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, and Talent Enablement functions in Pune, reporting to the global Chief Administrative Officer. This is a highly visible, locally-led role: you'll set the vision and operating rhythm for how OpenGov supports its India-based employees, while staying tightly aligned to global HR strategy and standards. You'll act as the senior HR voice in Pune, translating company-wide priorities into practices that work for the local market, and serving as the connective tissue between India leadership and our global People Team.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Pune HR team across HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, and Talent Enablement, setting priorities and ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery across all three functions
* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Pune business leadership, aligning local HR priorities with global business objectives while strengthening team performance, culture and retention
* Partner closely with US HR leadership and HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Tech, HR Ops, HRBPs, Talent Management) to adapt global programs for the India market without losing consistency
* Champion an AI-native culture within the Pune HR team and across the business, redesigning how teams work
* Own India-specific HR compliance, ensuring practices meet local labor law while reflecting OpenGov's global standards
* Lead organizational design, re-org, and change management efforts, including acquisition integration work
* Drive the local execution of HR programs, including performance management, compensation and benefit cycles, engagement surveys, and talent enablement initiatives
* Use HR data and metrics to identify local trends and opportunities, bringing insights back to global HR leadership
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee relations matters in Pune, partnering with Legal and global HR as needed
* Build strong, trust-based relationships across India and US stakeholders to keep HR operations and communication seamless across time zones

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with demonstrated experience leading HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, or Talent Enablement functions
* Experience managing or closely partnering with HR teams across multiple regions, including the US
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor law and compliance, with working familiarity with US employment practices
* Proven ability to lead and develop a team of HR professionals across multiple disciplines
* Excellent judgment and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
* High professional standards and a strong customer experience mentality with an energetic, positive attitude can quickly build partnerships, relationships, and trust
* Experience using AI-native tools to redesign workflows and improve efficiency
* Experience in high growth SaaS or technology-driven organizations preferred

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

**Senior Director, Global Delivery Hub – Pune, India**
======================================================

Zendesk  



  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. ### **Strategic Vision \& Business Leadership**

 Develop and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the Zendesk Global Delivery Hub in India, aligned with overall business goals and growth initiatives


 Lead the entire India AI consulting, data migration and custom development teams, driving customer adoption, growth and operational excellence

 Enable cross\-region coordination between global clients and India delivery teams to ensure seamless service delivery

 Manage key client relationships and serve as the primary executive stakeholder for major accounts

 Lead and develop the Global delivery organization in India, including recruiting, delivery, and operations teams

 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and employee development


 Energize and inspire people through empowerment, recognition, and passion

 Develop and optimize operational processes to enable scalability and growth


 Collaborate with Finance, HR, Compliance, Recruiting, and Operations to drive organizational effectiveness


 Mitigate risk and solve complex problems through innovative and out\-of\-the\-box thinking


 Manage continuity, change, and transition effectively in a dynamic environment

 Embody and model Zendesk values, mission, and vision


 Demonstrate integrity, develop people, and build high\-performing teams


 Drive organizational change and influence others toward shared goals


 Address the impact of attitude and action on the organization and its participants

 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, services delivery, staffing, or professional services organizations


 10\+ years of senior leadership experience managing P\&L, large teams, and complex operations at a regional or global scale


 Proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing organizations from the ground up


 Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency


 Experience managing key strategic client relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention


 Experience operating successfully in matrix organization structures


 Strong background in recruiting, talent development, and performance management


 Experience implementing operational improvements and continuous optimization initiatives


 Knowledge of India market dynamics and experience operating India\-based delivery centers highly preferred

Strives for customer success and exceeds expectations by understanding client needs and driving meaningful improvements in products and services. Takes a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.

Builds engaged, productive teams while sharing knowledge and collaborating effectively across roles, departments, and locations. Extends collaboration externally with partners and customers. Creates an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and leveraged.

Energizes and inspires teams through empowerment, recognition, and genuine passion for excellence. Manages continuity, change, and transition with grace. Skillfully influences and enables others to achieve shared objectives. Understands the impact of attitude and action on organizational success.

Possesses the skills and implements the functions of a transformational leader. Shares and communicates the company's values, mission, and vision effectively. Mitigates risk and solves complex problems through innovative, out\-of\-the\-box thinking and creative problem\-solving approaches. Challenges conventional wisdom and drives continuous improvement.

title: Director of Customer Experience, Sell
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**

  

Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology is responsible for developing and maintaining Private Capital specific programs and processes. Primary system is Private Capital Suite (fka Investran) and all the development tools associated with it. Design, develop, troubleshoot and improve change resilient application code and execute robust effective testing. Manage task and project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters. Flexibly work independently and as part of a team toward individual and team projects. From a product mindset perspective, engage in supporting applications (L2/L3\). Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance. Candidate will need to work afternoon shifts to support EMEA business users, including some weekend work when deploying code.

 **Experience/Skills**


Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Primary experience in dotnet and SQL stored procedures.
* Experience with project feasibility, definition requirements, design, testing and project delivery
* Experience with Agile project methodologies, CICD workflows, vulnerability management and issue remediation

Required Skills

* SQL
* dotnet
* REST APIs
* Terraform and IAAS
* Experience on working on Azure Cloud
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Work in a manner in keeping with the Northern Trust company’s core values
* Fast learner
* Self\-motivated

Preferred/ Recommended Skills:

* Experience in Private Capital and/or Financial industry
* PCS Live (fka Investran) experience
* Python
* Kafka
* Active Templates, Allocation Rules and Business Events

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: HR Support Coordinator
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.


At Stantec, we have some of the world’s leading professionals passionate about enabling our business to be its best. Our business teams include finance, procurement, human resources, information technology, marketing, corporate development, HSSE, real estate, legal, and practice services. We bring diverse backgrounds, skills, and expertise and create a caring culture where everyone can thrive. Through teamwork and collaboration, we’re building a stronger, more resilient Stantec every day.


Your Opportunity


Build your HR career with Stantec in a role where your organizational strengths, customer service mindset, and attention to detail will contribute to effective HR service delivery. As an HR Coordinator, you will support essential HR administration activities, including employee record management, professional qualification validation, preparation of letters and employment verifications, and responses to internal and external inquiries. In this role you will apply your organizational and time management skills, communicate with employees and partners, and provide support across all levels of the organization while managing a variety of administrative priorities in a fast\-paced, highly computerized environment.


As part of a collaborative HR team, you will support HR partners and employees across multiple time zones and help deliver reliable, responsive service across the organization.


Your Key Responsibilities


* HR Service Center Support: Be a key point of support for HR programs and procedures by managing HR Service Center tools, HR information systems, and team inboxes to help employees and partners receive timely, efficient responses.


* Employee Records: Update and maintain employee records, including Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) certifications and employee life\-cycle changes.


* Employee Documentation: Prepare and coordinate time\-sensitive employee letters and related documentation.


* Employment Verification: Respond to external employment and income verification requests.


* Qualifications Administration: Verify professional qualifications and record them accurately in employee records.


* File Management: Maintain electronic employee files and fulfill document and file maintenance requests.


* Service Delivery: Deliver HR services in accordance with established processes, procedures, and operational metrics that support effective service and best practices.


* HR Administration Coordination: Coordinate with HR teams, Payroll, and third\-party vendors to resolve HR administration service requests promptly.


* May perform other administrative tasks as assigned, such as invoice coordination, and Talent Acquisition tasks.


Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Experience completing administrative tasks, including preparing letters, correspondence, and related documentation.


* Strong professional customer service skills, with the flexibility to attend meetings during North American time zone hours.


* Ability to follow standard methods and procedures to complete primarily transactional work assignments.


* Strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills.


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, paired with a professional attitude; Fluency in English is required for this role


* Ability to stay focused, manage concurrent deadlines, and maintain close attention to detail.


* Comfort working with diverse individuals at all levels across a geographically dispersed organization.


* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.


* Ability to exercise confidentiality, discretion, and sound judgment.


* Ability to learn new processes quickly and adapt to changing priorities.


* Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills; advanced Excel experience is considered an asset.


* Ability to work independently and consistently meet role objectives.


Education and Experience


* Minimum 5 years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.


Typical office environment—working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time.


This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that may be required of the employee; other duties, responsibilities, and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.


Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other’s talents, do exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us. Join us and redefine your personal best.

title: HR Operations Team Leader​
description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly\-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly\-Clark, it’s all here for you \- innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.


You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes people and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your HR operations leadership, judgment, and customer focus to lead a team delivering critical cross\-entity HR services. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


About You


In this professional role, based in Pune, you’ll lead the HR Operations Coordinator team and be accountable for the end\-to\-end implementation and consistent execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes. You will ensure coordinators understand the process, systems, decision rules, and service expectations required to manage requests accurately and efficiently.


You will oversee case dispatch and workload allocation, monitor service levels, manage escalations, coach the team, and maintain strong governance and audit readiness. Strong leadership, sound judgment, confidentiality, analytical thinking, and a customer service mindset are critical to success in this role.


Job responsibilities include:


* Own the implementation and end\-to\-end execution of mapped cross\-entity HR processes in line with agreed design and governance.
* Ensure every coordinator understands the relevant processes, systems, decision rules, roles, and scope; onboard, upskill, and continuously coach the team.
* Assign and dispatch incoming cases to coordinators in ServiceNow, balancing workload and priority as team capability and volume evolve.
* Manage day\-to\-day operations including capacity planning, queue management, shift and holiday coverage, and backlog control.
* Monitor case volumes, turnaround times, quality, and service levels; report performance and act on trends before they become issues.
* Serve as the single escalation point for cross\-organization managers, HR Operations, Centers of Excellence, and HR Business Partner teams.
* Resolve or route complex and non\-standard cases, engage process owners when required, and communicate clear outcomes to stakeholders.
* Conduct quality reviews, provide regular feedback and development plans, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps promptly.
* Ensure delegated\-authority transactions are properly authorized, accurately documented, compliant, and audit\-ready.
* Safeguard sensitive and confidential employee information and ensure data privacy obligations are met across both companies.
* Identify recurring process gaps, operational risks, and system limitations, and partner with process owners on redesign and corrective action.
* Lead change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen service delivery and manager and employee experience.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:


Required Qualifications


* This is a fixed\-term contract lasting 18–24 months, with the shift running from 1:00PM to 10:00PM IST.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in HR Operations or HR Shared Services, including at least 2–3 years of experience leading or supervising a team.
* Proven experience implementing or stabilizing an HR process or service model, ideally within transformation, integration, or shared services.
* Solid end\-to\-end HR process knowledge across the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with case management tools such as ServiceNow, including queue management, case assignment, reporting, and SLA monitoring; working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Workday.
* Demonstrated ability to manage workload allocation, service levels, escalations, coaching, feedback, and performance for a distributed team.
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, problem\-solving, customer service, stakeholder management, and communication skills across levels and cultures.
* Proven discretion with sensitive employee data and sound understanding of data privacy, compliance, governance, and audit requirements.

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience working in a Global Business Services or HR Shared Services environment.
* Experience supporting global HR operations across different time zones and organizational cultures.
* Experience partnering with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, and non\-HR partner functions.
* Experience using operational data to identify process gaps, risks, service trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting HR transformation, integration, transition, or People Solutions activities.

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.


To Be Considered
  

  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.


In the meantime, please check out the careers website.


And finally, the fine print….

* Supports bringing new services into live by analyzing functional/non\-functional requirements, developing technical architecture options and recommendations

* Create test plans and schedules
* Create and implement test cases on project requirements
* Report defects and escalate issues
* Interact with team throughout development process

* Follow and analyze issues gathered in bug tracking system
